project: V153 なぜ深海の生き物は巨大化するのか？

rules.pan_scale: fixed 1.06; camera traverses the full available crop window (about 6% of frame width/height)
rules.pan_semantics: pan_right/pan_left describe camera travel across the still image, not the apparent motion of image pixels
rules.repetition_guard: the same motion is never assigned to three consecutive scenes
rules.subtitle_safe_area: bottom 130 px reserved for opaque black subtitle band; keep important visual content above it
rules.diagram_motion_override: If a board hint says pan but the image is a chart/diagram, the v2 readability rule wins: static or 1.00 -> 1.04 gentle zoom.
